title: ChatGPT or Claude? For just $40, you can ask them both (and many others).
excerpt: Compare up to six answers at once.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get AskAnyModel AI Pro for life for $39.99 and access 50+ AI models, compare up to six responses at once, and generate unlimited AI images across supported models.

Credit: AskAnyModel

$39.99
$499 Save $459.01

Having a favorite AI model is fine — and is actually pretty common. Keeping GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and a handful of others scattered across separate tabs is where things get messy. AskAnyModel AI Pro is now on sale for just $39.99 (reg. $499) for lifetime access, bringing 50+ AI models into one cloud-based workspace.

Its standout feature is side-by-side comparison. Pick two to six models, type your prompt once, and AskAnyModel sends it to all of them simultaneously. Responses appear together with response times and token counts, making it easier to compare different approaches without repeatedly copying and pasting prompts.

The model library includes 30 standard models with unlimited chats, including options from Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek, Gemma, Qwen, and others. There’s also a Pro Gemini model with Google Search grounding, limited to 300 chats per week.

For flagship models, you get 500 monthly premium credits to use across 19 options, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek Pro, Perplexity Search, and Mistral Large. So, importantly, lifetime access doesn’t mean unlimited use of every model.

AskAnyModel isn’t restricted to text, either. You can generate unlimited AI images across supported models without using premium credits, switch models during conversations, and use the platform for writing, coding, research, brainstorming, and content creation.

Everything runs through a modern web browser, with no downloads or updates required, and the model library is regularly refreshed.
